description: Niveaux de qualité de desserte en transport public is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoinformation Kanton Freiburg. Les niveaux de qualité de desserte sont un indicateur de la desserte en transport public. En fonction de la cadence de desserte d'un arrêt de transport public et du type de transport le desservant, la zone adjacente à ce dernier se voit attribuer un niveau de qualité de desserte. Coverage: Geoinformation Kanton Freiburg. The portal files it under the publisher Geoinformation Kanton Freiburg. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
